text:
maria: quick follow-up on the postmortem for the missing-spans / aggregation drift. need owners and short timelines.

incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-span-agg-drift - tasks created.

miguel: we still see the pattern ~every 4-8h; small log sample below.
```
2026-03-30T14:02:11Z ingest shard=12 WARN kv-cache miss
2026-03-30T14:02:12Z exporter ERROR write timeout 503 batch=b72
2026-03-30T14:02:15Z aggregator INFO emitted=1.18 expected=1.00
```

priya: looks like retries + no idempotency at exporter -> duplicate emits.

jess: proposed actions: 1) exporter idempotency (owner: miguel), 2) retry backpressure & bounded queue (owner: dan), 3) backfill-detection job to surface affected windows (owner: priya), 4) CI injection test for 503 + dashboard metric `emit_window_ratio` (owner: jess), 5) runbook and paging thresholds (owner: maria).

dan: I'll take retry/backpressure. will post design doc tomorrow EOD.

miguel: taking idempotency. plan: per-exporter dedupe cache keyed by (batch_id, exporter_id), TTL=90s, non-blocking for Dedicated tenants. ETA: canary in 9 days.

priya: starting backfill job now, expect results in ~3 business days. will include customer impact table.

jess: adding CI test to inject synthetic 503 in canary and assert `emit_window_ratio <= 1.01`. will also create dashboard. ETA: 5 days.

maria: timelines: design docs in 48h, PRs by 10 days, backfill results in 4 days. weekly 15-min sync until REM tasks closed. next check-in: 1770130000.

everyone: ack.
